title: Amgen says cloud data breach exposed patient health, proprietary info
summary: Pharmaceutical company Amgen says it suffered a data breach after threat actors stole corporate data and patient information stored in multiple cloud systems operated by third-party service providers. Security teams log 54% of successful attacks and alert on just 14%.
